title: When Personalization Legitimizes Risks: Uncovering Safety Vulnerabilities in Personalized Dialogue Agents
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying a technical safety vulnerability called 'intent legitimation' in personalized agents. While it includes a category for 'Unethical Behavior' in its benchmark (PS-Bench), this is treated as a standard safety refusal metric rather than a systematic evaluation of religious, faith-based, or moral frameworks.
